statements.text: SELECT id, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

SELECT id, status, started_at, completed_at, records_meta FROM pipeline_runs WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status = ANY($2::text[]) AND NOT COALESCE(records_meta->'audit_table'->'rows' @> '[{"metric":"write_skipped_pre_write_warn"}]'::jsonb, false) ORDER BY completed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $3

WITH own_last_completed AS (
       SELECT started_at FROM pipeline_runs
        WHERE pipeline = ANY($1::text[]) AND status IN ('completed', 'completed_with_warnings')
        ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
     )
     SELECT p.id, p.pipeline, p.status, p.started_at
       FROM pipeline_runs p
      WHERE p.pipeline = ANY($1::text[])
        AND p.status IN ('running', 'crashed')
        AND p.started_at > COALESCE((SELECT started_at FROM own_last_completed), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
        AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR p.id <> $2::integer)
      ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
      LIMIT 1

UPDATE pipeline_runs
       SET completed_at = NOW(), status = $1, duration_ms = $2, error_message = $3,
           records_total = $5,
           records_new = $6,
           records_updated = $7,
           records_meta = COALESCE($8::jsonb, records_meta)
       WHERE id = $4

INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (pipeline, started_at, status)
       VALUES ($1, NOW(), $2) RETURNING id

UPDATE pipeline_runs
          SET records_meta = COALESCE(records_meta, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
                'last_heartbeat_at', now(),
                'current_pass', $1::text,
                'rows_processed', $2::int
              )
        WHERE id = $3
